translations.web: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”
translations.bsb: But how he can now see or who opened his eyes, we do not know. Ask him. He is old enough to speak for himself.”
translations.kjv: But by what means he now seeth, we know not; or who hath opened his eyes, we know not: he is of age; ask him: he shall speak for himself.
translations.asv: but how he now seeth, we know not; or who opened his eyes, we know not: ask him; he is of age; he shall speak for himself.
